topIssues.title: Feedback: `BlockNotFoundError` in Step 5 (Prove the withdrawal on L1)
topIssues.author: opfocus
topIssues.body: While following the **[ETH bridge tutorial with Viem](https://docs.optimism.io/app-developers/tutorials/bridging/cross-dom-bridge-eth#withdraw-eth)** (OP Sepolia → Sepolia), I ran into a `BlockNotFoundError` at **Step 5 – Prove the withdrawal on the L1**, inside `buildProveWithdrawal`. The error happens because the `output` returned in **Step 4 – Wait for withdrawal prove** is incorrect. Specifically, the `l2BlockNumber` value looks like a timestamp (e.g. `1768953611`) rather than a valid L2 block number, which later causes `getBlock` to fail. After some investigation, this `output` seems to come from an invalid dispute game created by: * **EOA**: [0xbAA4165C68C1A02b435E85575505A494aDc98B93](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0xa74a8d2b98762d24ac55aa4ba158fecf316da850e61fc23dc51e2f2a4bb81926) * **DisputeGameFactoryProxy**: `0x05F9613aDB30026FFd634f38e5C4dFd30a197Fa1` This issue currently affects the tutorial example when following the documented steps. This address is repeatedly doing the same thing. I don't know if this indicates a problem; it looks like a test or a prank.

topPRs.author: dhyaniarun1993
topPRs.body:
**Description**

This PR adds comprehensive configuration reference documentation for `op-reth` and the `op-rs` fork supporting historical proofs.

### Changes
- **New Page**: `node-operators/reference/op-reth-config.mdx`
  - Created a complete reference guide for `op-reth` command-line flags (General, Networking, RPC, TxPool, Debug, Database, etc.) matching the output of `op-reth node --help`.
  - Added specific sections for "Static Files" and "Rollup".
- **New Page**: `node-operators/reference/op-reth-historical-proof-config.mdx`
  - Created a reference guide for the `op-rs/op-reth` fork specific functionality.
  - Documented `proofs-history` flags.
  - Added a "Management Commands" section documenting `op-reth proofs init`, `prune`, and `unwind`.

- **Updated**: `node-operators/guides/configuration/execution-clients.mdx`
  - Updated the "op-reth" tab to link to the new configuration reference page.
  - Added a link to the historical proof configuration for users running the `op-rs` fork.
- **Updated**: `mint.json`
  - Registered the new pages in the navigation sidebar under **Node Operators > Reference**.

Closes https://github.com/op-rs/op-reth/issues/441

topPRs.title: docs: add Custom Gas Token v2 documentation
topPRs.author: sbvegan
topPRs.body:
Add comprehensive documentation for Custom Gas Token (CGT) v2:
- Feature overview in OP Stack Features section
- Deployment guide for chain operators
- Updated fact sheet to reflect CGT support
- Navigation updates in docs.json

The CGT v2 implementation (introduced in Upgrade 18, op-contracts/v6.0.0) enables OP Stack chains to use any asset as their native fee currency through a flexible, application-layer architecture with two new predeploy contracts: NativeAssetLiquidity and LiquidityController.

Documentation includes:
- Architecture overview with mermaid diagrams
- Deployment steps using op-deployer (with TODOs for specific commands)
- Configuration examples and best practices
- Risk considerations and troubleshooting
- Cross-references between feature overview and deployment guide
